text:
maria: Heads-up — proposing we triage candidate 'Orchid-lite-v2' for focused quant experiments this sprint. Quick pulse on priority?
joel: :eyes: curious — what's the current fp16 baseline (perf + quality)?
maria: baseline on 1xA10: 14.2 tps, avg latency 95ms, p95 ~180ms for 512 tokens. Eval-harness QA pass = 91.2%, summarization rouge-L 0.82.
sam: If 4-bit gets ~2x cost reduction with <=1.5% quality drop vs fp16, it's worth allocating infra. 8-bit is lower risk.
rachel: +1. Also need a minimal bring-up checklist so infra can queue canary nodes. @nina can you reserve 2xA10 canary?
nina: deploy-bot triggered request: reserved 2xA10 canaries in staging-east for 3 days. :white_check_mark:
maria: here's the quick bring-up checklist (minimal):
- smoke-quant: run single-shard 8-bit quant with `tools/quantize --mode=8bit --calib=1k`
- smoke-eval: run eval-harness probe set (n=2k prompts) w/ compare to fp16 baseline
- perf-run: batching sweep (batch_size=1,4,8) to collect tps and p95
- regression-gate: block if QA-pass drops >0.5% or rouge-L drops >0.02
- canary-rollout: 3% traffic for 12hrs, monitor errors/latency
joel: Add SLO: p95 < 300ms for 512 tokens in canary, and token cost target < $0.012/token (approx).
sam: For experiments: run 8-bit first, then try 4-bit with PerChannelQuant + GPTQ fallback if 4-bit fails. Keep quant seeds logged.
maria: command examples: `./bin/quantize --model orchid-lite-v2 --bits 8 --calib-file /tmp/calib.json && ./bin/eval-harness --model quantized/model8 --suite qa_probe2000 --out /tmp/out.json`
rachel: can we add a small adversarial prompt set (10 examples) to catch hallucination/regression? I can paste a starter file.
maria: yes, add `adversarial/quick-smoke.json` to the run. If any fail, tag with `regression:hallucination` in the report.
joel: timeline proposal: start smoke-quant today -> perf & eval tomorrow -> canary by EOD Thursday. Does that fit?
sam: fits from ML side. I'll own the 4-bit run if 8-bit is promising.
nina: infra notes: need Docker image update for quant runtime (`runtime:quant-v3`). Will push to staging by EOD.
maria: gating thresholds recap: QA-pass delta <= 0.5%, rouge-L delta <= 0.02, p95 <= 300ms. If all green -> proceed to 3% canary.
rachel: decision: prioritize this above new candidate triage because customer-facing latency matters. :thumbsup:
joel: OK good. Action items:
- maria: run initial 8-bit smoke (today) -> ts 2500346840
- nina: push runtime image and confirm canary nodes (today) -> ts 2500346860
- sam: prepare 4-bit experiment plan (standby) -> ts 2500346880
- rachel: assemble adversarial prompt set + monitoring dashboard widgets -> ts 2500346900
- joel: update rollouts config with SLOs & cost targets -> ts 2500346920
maria: I'll post a short summary + results in #eng-ml when smoke finishes. Thanks team. :raised_hands:
deploy-bot: Canary cluster created (staging-east, 2xA10). Logs accessible at https://infra.internal/canaries/2500346789
joel: leaving this open for updates — please ping if any regressions show up.
